title: Bi-Lagrangian and transverse Dirac structures induced on the Whitney sum
summary: Let $(M,ω,\mathcal{F}_1,\mathcal{F}_2)$ be a bi-Lagrangian manifold. For a distribution $\mathcal{D}\subseteq TM$, we characterize when the subbundle $N^{*t}\mathcal{D}:=\mathcal{D}\oplus N^*\mathcal{D}$ of the Whitney sum $W=TM\oplus T^*M$ is a Dirac structure for both the untwisted and $(H,θ)$-twisted Courant brackets.
